breakthrough: The same capability runs efficiently from phone to server
lane: Model fabric, activation, routing, and readiness
outcome: Compile model graphs for the exact CPU, GPU, NPU, memory, and latency budget available

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Hardware Aware Inference Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Hardware Aware Inference Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed source inputs, intermediate representation, validation passes, and generated targets required to compile model graphs for the exact cpu, gpu, npu, memory, and latency budget available, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for language and multimodal models, adapters, inference engines, evaluation, hardware placement, and model evolution; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Hardware Aware Inference Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: compile model graphs for the exact cpu, gpu, npu, memory, and latency budget available.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Hardware Aware Inference Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Hardware Aware Inference Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using mixture routing, distillation, ensemble learning, synthetic evaluation, and hardware-aware compilation.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Hardware Aware Inference Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the model workbench, inference map, evaluator arena, and model genome browser, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Hardware Aware Inference into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Hardware Aware Inference Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Hardware Aware Inference Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: The same capability runs efficiently from phone to server. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.

title: Hardware-Aware Inference Compiler
